Meet Your Coach

I've been where you are. I know the way back.

Hi, I'm Sam. I'm a sports physical therapist and semi-professional skier with years of experience helping people recover from sports injuries, surgeries, and more, all online and on your schedule.

Back-to-back injuries, stronger than ever. ACL, meniscus, ski laceration, torn ankle ligaments. Across three season-ending injuries, I've lived the rehab process myself, not just studied it, and that's what shapes the way I coach.

My approach combines evidence-based rehab techniques with a deeply personal touch. I don't believe in cookie-cutter programs. Every body is different, every injury is different, and your recovery plan should reflect that.

Sports Physical Therapist, 5+ years experience
Semi-professional skier & competitive athlete
Lived through 3 major injury recoveries himself
Evidence-based, personalised programmes

My Story

Three injuries. Three comebacks.
One mission.

The past three years have been intense. I've faced multiple season-ending injuries, and if you've ever been through it, you know it's not just your body that hurts.

1

I've Been Where You Are

An ACL and meniscus tear in March 2024, a massive ski laceration almost exactly a year later, and most recently, two torn ankle ligaments in September 2025. The first two required surgery and all of them a long, grueling rehab.

2

Rehab Isn't Just Physical

The mental side can feel endless: loneliness, frustration, fear, and self-doubt creep in when you're lying on the couch, counting the days until you can move again. Some days I did everything "right" and it still felt like nothing was moving. I was angry, frustrated, and honestly pretty low.

"Rehab isn't just physical. The mental side can feel endless."
3

What My Injuries Taught Me

As a semi-professional skier and a sports physical therapist, I've learned strategies that truly work, the kind that bridge the gap between "healed" and "ready to perform." Multiple major injuries taught me how to rebuild not just strength, but confidence and trust in your body, which is often the hardest part of recovery.

4

Why I Coach

Now, I help athletes navigate injury recovery with personalized, 1-on-1 coaching. Whether it's physical rehab, preventing re-injury, or tackling the mental side of returning to sport, I guide you step by step, so you can return stronger, safer, and more confident than ever.
